result:
I added the enrollment date and time to the class enrollment screens. I only checked that the helper parses (`ruby -c`). I did not run the tests or open the screens.

Enrollments in class sections (`ClassEnrollment`) already store `created_at`, so I changed no database schema. The list and the detail view now show a "Data da inscrição" column, in `dd/mm/YYYY HH:MM` format, in the app's time zone. The column can be sorted. If a record has no `created_at`, it shows "data desconhecida" instead of an invented date.

The changes are in `class_enrollments_controller.rb`, `class_enrollments_helper.rb` and `class_enrollment.pt-BR.yml`. The screen is still behind the existing `authorize_resource`, so no new profile can see it.

I did not build adjustment-period detection, a date filter or an export. The adjustment period isn't modelled anywhere I looked, and defining it would mean a schema change, which the issue says to ask about first. For now, you can pick out adjustment-period enrollments by sorting on the new date column.
